Q5347.reason: Existing muscle ATP covers the first 1–2 seconds of maximal force; phosphocreatine then regenerates ATP, and glycolysis comes later.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani the Grand Chamber held 9–8 that upholding Kuwait’s state immunity did not violate Article 6, so immunity prevailed over the fair-trial claim.
